Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform successfully retrieved the list of child containers for the

application/json

An array of child account UUIDs that you want to link with the parent
account.
]

— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
